content.short: Genies offers avatar design and creation tools.
content.description: Genies is an avatar ecosystem that includes avatars, fashion and collectibles, spaces and venues, and social experiences. The platform provides a cohesive set of tools to bring these elements to life, empowering users to design their own avatars, assemble wearable fashion lines, build avatar worlds, and create interactive experiences within Web3. Central to the offering is the Genies Avatar Creator OS, a dedicated creator toolset that supports customization, styling, and world-building across the Genies ecosystem.
content.meta: Genies is an avatar ecosystem of avatars, fashion and collectibles, and social experiences. Discover Genies and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.tldr: A text window is fine for roleplay; an animated persona adds voice, expression and presence. The choice is about how a character shows up.

resources.title: Why Auto Rigging Matters for Cross-Platform Avatars
resources.tldr: Most avatars are stuck in the game they were made for. Automating bone-binding frees them, but only within a framework that travels too.

resources.title: A Guide to Building a Virtual Character
resources.tldr: Most AI is a faceless text box: intelligent, but hard to form a connection with. The argument that identity is the missing piece.
